task: Set up a green-screen keyed layout. 1. OBS may start with a default 'Scene'. 2. Create a scene named exactly 'Live'. 3. In the 'Live' scene, add an Image source named exactly 'WebCam' whose file is /home/user/Pictures/green_plate.png. 4. Apply a Chroma Key filter to the 'WebCam' source. Name the filter exactly 'Green Screen'. 5. Configure the filter: Key Color Type = Green, Similarity = 420, Smoothness = 100. 6. The 'WebCam' source must be visible. 7. Close OBS or let it auto-save.

verification.description: 'Green Screen' filter is a chroma key filter
Chroma key color type is green (OBS omits the default 'green' from the saved settings)
